artifact_observations.location: Global, especially background and edges of subjects
artifact_observations.reasoning: Significant motion blur and out-of-focus areas degrade structural clarity, typical of old digital cameras or film scans, but also common in AI generations trying to mimic 'lo-fi' aesthetics.
The hair lacks fine strand detail, appearing as smudged masses. While partly due to resolution, it also resembles AI 'smearing' where individual strands fail to resolve into distinct lines.
The tongue and mouth area of the background figure appear distorted and anatomically ambiguous, blending into the face in a way that suggests generation artifacts or severe compression distortion.
